recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast studio group portrait of four men in black leather jackets against a stark white background, framed by a thick black border with a horizontal red accent bar at the top and bottom containing bold slab-serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast black leather textures against a flat white void
Red typographic bars anchoring the top and bottom edges
Pyramidal composition of subjects with overlapping shoulders
Direct eye contact creating a serious, confrontational mood
coreInvariants: Primary red accent color for text and bars

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four subjects arranged in a tight cluster; one central figure in the foreground, flanked by two slightly behind, and one elevated in the background.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central bearded figure's face and the red horizontal bars.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top red text, move down the central column of faces, and rest on the bottom text bar.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Pure white space surrounding the heads and shoulders, contained within a black frame.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between white background and black leather; high saturation red for graphic elements.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif with consistent stroke weight
characterSpecificRedesigns: None; standard geometric slab serif characteristics

composition.relationshipToImage: Overlays the graphic frame, not the subjects

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used for both title and subtitle for cohesive branding.

candidateDirections.reason: Classic geometric slab serif with similar weight and blocky terminals.
Provides the heavy slab feel with slightly more bracketed serifs.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast studio portrait of four men in black leather jackets against a pure white background. Frame the image with a thick black border and include a white inner margin. Add a horizontal red bar at the top left and bottom left edges.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Using a bold slab-serif font like Rockwell, typeset the title in all-caps in red over the top bar and the subtitle in all-caps in red over the bottom bar.

verificationChecks: Are the jackets black leather with visible highlights?
Is the typography a heavy slab serif?
Are the red bars positioned at the top and bottom edges?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subjects
Any logos or brand-specific markings on the clothing

mustAchieve: Clean graphic lines in the framing

postGenerationChecks: Check for high contrast between subjects and background
Ensure the red bars do not overlap the subjects' heads
Verify the slab serif font is bold and legible
Confirm the black border is uniform on all sides
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + Leather Texture + White Void + Red/Black Graphic Framing + Slab Serif Typography
